completed: Fixed the live P0.0 blocker: the MCP launcher used os.execv, which on Windows starts a second process and exits the first, so Claude Code saw its child die mid-handshake and timed out after 30s. The launcher now resolves the checkout and serves in-process.
Hardened launcher-verify to hold the spawned process open across a real handshake and fail if it exits; the old subprocess.run/EOF check could not see this class of bug.

Removed machine-specific checkout paths from canonical adapter text (adapters/global/AGENTS.md, .agents/skills/personal-agent-os/SKILL.md) via an AGENT_OS_REPOSITORY placeholder rendered at install time; refreshed the drifted codex installs.

Regraded context pruning by usefulness: the previous handoff is graded rather than dropped whole, so its decisions and remaining work (the next action) outlive broad state, lexical matches and skill metadata.
Added a final squeeze that sheds the static selection description and generic summary before truncating the task, making the documented 250-token floor real.
Registered Agent OS with Claude Desktop, taking integration-health to ok=true with every surface at or above its expected tier.
decisions: The launcher must never hand the session to a replacement process; regression tests assert both the source shape and live process survival.
Canonical Git adapter text stays machine-independent; the concrete checkout belongs only in the rendered local install.
A handoff's completed/validation narrative is generic bulk, but its decisions/remaining are the next action and rank with task-selected context.
remaining: P0.1 Staged Workflow Orchestrator is not started and is now safe to begin.
ChatGPT chat/Work surfaces stay partially bridged by design; no automatic preflight exists for those hosts.
Nothing is committed or pushed; the branch p0-0-universal-routing holds two earlier commits plus these uncommitted changes, and main has advanced on origin.
claude_desktop_config.json stores an IMAP password in plaintext (pre-existing, unrelated to Agent OS).
